note_en: 除了…还… means "besides... also...": 除了晒太阳，很多人还会去南山寺 "besides soaking up the sun, many people also go to Nanshan Temple." English can put "also" in several places, but Chinese 还 must come right before the verb (还会去), never at the start of the clause. The same pattern appears in 除了海鲜，炭烤生蚝…也是…美食, where 也 plays the role of 还, and in Xiao Zhou's closing thought 除了大海，还有山，有岛.
